The estimated chance that asteroid 2024 YR4 would hit Earth on December 22, 2032 rose from about 1.2% in late January 2025 to a peak of 3.1% on February 18, then fell to nearly zero by the end of February. (assets.science.nasa.gov)
| Date in 2025 | Estimated chance of an Earth impact |
|---|---|
| Late January | About 1.2%, above the 1% threshold for issuing a formal notification. (assets.science.nasa.gov) |
| February 7 | NASA reported 2.3%. (science.nasa.gov) |
| February 18 | The estimate peaked at 3.1% for NASA and 2.8% for the European Space Agency (ESA). (science.nasa.gov) |
| February 24–25 | NASA reported 0.004% and ESA reported 0.001%. Both concluded the asteroid posed no significant threat to Earth. (science.nasa.gov) |
The asteroid’s path didn’t change; astronomers’ estimates of it did. Early observations narrowed the range of possible paths while Earth was still in that range, so a larger share of the remaining paths led to an impact. Further observations ruled out almost all of those paths. NASA’s later 2025 updates about a possible Moon impact did not raise the risk to Earth. (blogs.esa.int)

quotes.text: However, 2024 YR4’s IP increased over the 52 days after its discovery and reached a high of 3.1% on 18 Feb 2025 before finally falling below the 1% threshold on 20 Feb 2025.

After seven weeks of additional observation, the worldwide coalition, coordinating through formal and informal networks, enabled the planetary defense community to successfully refine 2024 YR4’s IP down to nearly zero and determine it posed no threat to Earth for the next century.

On 24 Feb 2025, Dr. Fast provided the required notifications19 to NASA members and interagency members about 2024 YR4, this time telling them of the IP dropping to 0.004% and providing no significant potential for future impact.

ultimately led to ruling out the possibility 19 Appendix B – NASA Potential Impact Notifications for 2024 YR4 20 Appendix C – IAWN Potential Impact Notifications for 2024 YR4
25 of Earth impact on 22 Dec 2032.

pages.quote_reason: The quotes state the impact probability fell below 1% on 20 Feb 2025, dropped to 0.004% by 24 Feb 2025 (nearly zero), and that the 22 Dec 2032 impact was ruled out, so every fact in the claim is backed.
pages.page_reason: The page states the impact probability dropped below 1% on 20 Feb 2025, fell to 0.004% by 24 Feb 2025, and that the possibility of Earth impact on 22 Dec 2032 was ruled out, which supports the claim that it fell to nearly zero by end of February 2025.
